## Moventra TMS — Pull Request

### Scope

Describe the change and the official implementation phase it belongs to.

### Evidence

- [ ] Change is tied to one official phase/gate.
- [ ] No dependent phase was implemented ahead of its prerequisite gate.
- [ ] CI checks are green or failures are explicitly documented.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Data/tenant isolation impact was assessed when applicable.
- [ ] Migration/rollback impact was assessed when applicable.
- [ ] Observability/audit impact was assessed when applicable.
- [ ] Documentation/ADR was updated when the change introduces an architectural decision.

### Deployment / rollback

State the deployment target and rollback strategy, or mark as not applicable with justification.

### Gate impact

State whether this PR provides evidence toward a gate. A gate must not be approved solely because the PR was merged.
